title: Warm Welsh Slate-Tile Baked British Date Night Welsh Dish Bake
description: A sour, crisp, date-night British dish featuring a tangy tomato sauce and a creamy mantecare emulsion. This recipe is egg-free friendly and is best served on a warm Welsh slate tile.

ingredients.name: Mantecare
ingredients.notes: Ensure the mantecare is at room temperature before using.

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: Leave the butter at room temperature.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality olive oil.

instructions: Mix the chopped thyme, parsley, and garlic together in a small bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the mantecare, sugar, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the red wine vinegar and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the saucepan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the lemon juice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the mantecare mixture to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a 20x20cm slate tile baking dish.
Dot the top of the mixture with the unsalted butter.
Sprinkle the minced thyme and parsley over the top of the mixture.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Warm Welsh Slate-Tile Baked British Date Night Welsh Dish Bake warm, garnished with additional thyme and parsley if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
